title: New phones from Ozmobiles?
body:
O.P.
Has anyone bought new phones from Ozmobiles before?
I wouldn't buy a refurbished phone, but they sell new ones too. Are their new phones legitimately new, unsued, sealed stock?
With a discount code a new iPhone 17 pro is only $1839, which is by far the cheapest I've found.

---- replies ----
[User #2339991803 postsSnapper17Whirlpool Enthusiast] I have not bought from ozmobiles However just wanted to tell you that you can get 10% discounted gift cards for apple and jb hifi. From the supermarkets, it alternates each week. So $2000 – 10% would be $1800
Also jb have a mobile plan deal https://www.jbhifi.com.a u/pages/upfront-mobile-plans
$84 per month (84x24=2016) you get a $1000 jb card that you can use on the phone you then pay $1000 extra (or 900 if you get the discounted jb cards) to buy the phone and you have a plan through telstra network with 300gb data a month
Also the 17 base model is on special at jb for around $1330
What features on the pro are you after? it has a better chip and one extra lens on the camera. Is that worth the extra $670?
